name: continuousSingularFractionBesselBoundary_eq_exactNumerator_effectiveConfidence
statement:
theorem continuousSingularFractionBesselBoundary_eq_exactNumerator_effectiveConfidence
    (prior : Measure Theta) (X : Theta → Nat → Omega → Real)
    (posterior : Measure Theta) {delta lam : Real}
    (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hlam_pos : 0 < lam)
    (hlam : lam ≤ Real.exp (-1)) (n : Nat) (omega : Omega) :
    continuousSingularFractionBesselBoundary
        prior X posterior delta lam n omega =
      singularFractionExactNumerator
          (continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty
            posterior X n omega)
          (continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence
            prior posterior delta)
          lam /
        (n : Real)
proof:
:= by
  let Q := continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty posterior X n omega
  let L := singularFractionLogScale lam
  let A := L * (L + 1)
  have hL : 1 ≤ L := by
    simpa [L] using one_le_singularFractionLogScale hlam_pos hlam
  have hA : 0 < A := by
    dsimp [A]
    exact mul_pos (zero_lt_one.trans_le hL) (by linarith)
  have hlog := continuousSingularFractionBessel_log_effectiveConfidence
    prior posterior hdelta hA
  unfold continuousSingularFractionBesselBoundary
    singularFractionExactNumerator
  change
    (lam * Q + Real.exp 1 / lam *
        ((InformationTheory.klDiv posterior prior).toReal +
          Real.log (A / delta))) /
        (n : Real) =
      (lam * Q + Real.exp 1 / lam *
        Real.log
          (A / continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence
            prior posterior delta)) /
        (n : Real)
  rw [hlog]

name: continuousSingularFractionExactBoundary_le_pacBayesBoundary
statement:
theorem continuousSingularFractionExactBoundary_le_pacBayesBoundary
    (prior : Measure Theta) (X : Theta → Nat → Omega → Real)
    (posterior : Measure Theta) {delta lam : Real}
    (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hdelta_one : delta ≤ 1)
    (hlam_pos : 0 < lam) (hlam : lam ≤ Real.exp (-1))
    (n : Nat) (omega : Omega)
    (hQ : 0 ≤ continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty
      posterior X n omega) :
    singularFractionExactBoundary
          (continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty posterior X n omega)
          (continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence
            prior posterior delta) /
        (n : Real) ≤
      continuousSingularFractionBesselBoundary
        prior X posterior delta lam n omega
proof:
:= by
  have heffective_pos :=
    continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence_pos
      prior posterior hdelta
  have heffective_one :=
    continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence_le_one
      prior posterior hdelta hdelta_one
  rw [continuousSingularFractionBesselBoundary_eq_exactNumerator_effectiveConfidence
    prior X posterior hdelta hlam_pos hlam n omega]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
    (singularFractionExactBoundary_le
      hQ heffective_pos heffective_one hlam_pos hlam)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg n)

name: singularFractionExactBoundary_le_observableLIL
statement:
theorem singularFractionExactBoundary_le_observableLIL
    {Q delta : Real} (hQ : 0 ≤ Q)
    (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hdelta_one : delta ≤ 1) :
    singularFractionExactBoundary Q delta ≤
      singularFractionObservableLILBoundary Q delta
proof:
:= by
  let lam := singularFractionObservableTunedLambda Q delta
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by
    simpa [lam] using singularFractionObservableTunedLambda_pos Q delta
  have hlam : lam ≤ Real.exp (-1) := by
    simpa [lam] using
      singularFractionObservableTunedLambda_le_exp_neg_one Q delta
  have hminimum := singularFractionExactBoundary_le
    hQ hdelta hdelta_one hlam_pos hlam
  have henvelope := singularFraction_tunedBoundary_le_observableLIL
    hQ hdelta hdelta_one
  exact hminimum.trans (by
    simpa [singularFractionExactNumerator, lam] using henvelope)

name: continuousSingularFractionExactBoundary_le_observableLIL
statement:
theorem continuousSingularFractionExactBoundary_le_observableLIL
    (prior posterior : Measure Theta)
    (X : Theta → Nat → Omega → Real)
    {delta : Real} (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hdelta_one : delta ≤ 1)
    (n : Nat) (omega : Omega)
    (hQ : 0 ≤ continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty
      posterior X n omega) :
    singularFractionExactBoundary
        (continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty posterior X n omega)
        (continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence
          prior posterior delta) ≤
      singularFractionObservableLILBoundary
        (continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty posterior X n omega)
        (continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence
          prior posterior delta)
proof:
:= by
  apply singularFractionExactBoundary_le_observableLIL hQ
  · exact continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence_pos
      prior posterior hdelta
  · exact continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence_le_one
      prior posterior hdelta hdelta_one

name: exists_continuousTwoSidedSingularFractionExactOptimalPACBayes_event
statement:
theorem exists_continuousTwoSidedSingularFractionExactOptimalPACBayes_event
    [IsProbabilityMeasure mu]
    (prior : Measure Theta) [IsProbabilityMeasure prior]
    {X mean : Theta → Nat → Omega → Real} {delta : Real}
    (hdelta : 0 < delta) (hdelta_one : delta ≤ 1)
    (hX_adapted : ∀ theta, IncrementAdapted F (X theta))
    (hmean_adapted : ∀ theta, StronglyAdapted F (mean theta))
    (hX_unit : ∀ theta k omega,
      X theta k omega ∈ Set.Icc (0 : Real) 1)
    (hmean_unit : ∀ theta k omega,
      mean theta k omega ∈ Set.Icc (0 : Real) 1)
    (hmean : ∀ theta k,
      mu[X theta k | F k] =ᵐ[mu] mean theta k)
    (hX_parameter : ∀ k omega,
      StronglyMeasurable (fun theta => X theta k omega))
    (hmean_parameter : ∀ k omega,
      StronglyMeasurable (fun theta => mean theta k omega))
    (hjoint_lower_ambient : ∀ n, StronglyMeasurable
      (fun q : Omega × (Real × Theta) =>
        forwardPredictableMeanEmpiricalBernsteinLowerProcess
          (X q.2.2) (mean q.2.2) (singularFraction q.2.1) n q.1))
    (hjoint_lower_filtered : ∀ n,
      StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.prod (F n) inferInstance]
        (fun q : Omega × (Real × Theta) =>
          forwardPredictableMeanEmpiricalBernsteinLowerProcess
            (X q.2.2) (mean q.2.2)
              (singularFraction q.2.1) n q.1))
    (hjoint_upper_ambient : ∀ n, StronglyMeasurable
      (fun q : Omega × (Real × Theta) =>
        forwardPredictableMeanEmpiricalBernsteinLowerProcess
          (fun k omega => 1 - X q.2.2 k omega)
          (fun k omega => 1 - mean q.2.2 k omega)
          (singularFraction q.2.1) n q.1))
    (hjoint_upper_filtered : ∀ n,
      StronglyMeasurable[MeasurableSpace.prod (F n) inferInstance]
        (fun q : Omega × (Real × Theta) =>
          forwardPredictableMeanEmpiricalBernsteinLowerProcess
            (fun k omega => 1 - X q.2.2 k omega)
            (fun k omega => 1 - mean q.2.2 k omega)
            (singularFraction q.2.1) n q.1)) :
    ∃ goodEvent : Set Omega,
      mu.real goodEventᶜ ≤ delta ∧
        ∀ omega ∈ goodEvent,
          ∀ posterior : Measure Theta,
            IsProbabilityMeasure posterior → posterior ≪ prior →
            Integrable (llr posterior prior) posterior →
            ∀ n : Nat, 2 ≤ n →
              |(∫ theta, forwardPrefixMean
                    (fun k => mean theta k omega) n ∂posterior) -
                (∫ theta, forwardPrefixMean
                    (fun k => X theta k omega) n ∂posterior)| <
                singularFractionExactBoundary
                    (continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty
                      posterior X n omega)
                    (continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence
                      prior posterior (delta / 2)) /
                  (n : Real)
proof:
:= by
  rcases
      exists_continuousTwoSidedSingularFractionBesselPACBayes_allFractions_event
        (mu := mu) (F := F) prior hdelta hdelta_one hX_adapted
        hmean_adapted hX_unit hmean_unit hmean hX_parameter
        hmean_parameter hjoint_lower_ambient hjoint_lower_filtered
        hjoint_upper_ambient hjoint_upper_filtered with
    ⟨goodEvent, hmass, hall⟩
  refine ⟨goodEvent, hmass, ?_⟩
  intro omega homega posterior hposterior hposterior_prior hllr n hn
  letI : IsProbabilityMeasure posterior := hposterior
  let Q := continuousForwardPosteriorHybridBesselPenalty
    posterior X n omega
  let effectiveDelta := continuousSingularFractionBesselEffectiveConfidence
    prior posterior (delta / 2)
  let lamStar := singularFractionExactOptimalLambda Q effectiveDelta
  have hdelta_half : 0 < delta / 2 := by linarith
  have hlamStar_pos : 0 < lamStar := by
    simpa [lamStar] using
      singularFractionExactOptimalLambda_pos Q effectiveDelta
  have hlamStar : lamStar ≤ Real.exp (-1) := by
    simpa [lamStar] using
      singularFractionExactOptimalLambda_le_exp_neg_one Q effectiveDelta
  have hbound := hall omega homega posterior inferInstance
    hposterior_prior hllr n hn lamStar hlamStar_pos hlamStar
  have hbridge :=
    continuousSingularFractionBesselBoundary_eq_exactNumerator_effectiveConfidence
      prior X posterior hdelta_half hlamStar_pos hlamStar n omega
  rw [hbridge] at hbound
  simpa [Q, effectiveDelta, lamStar, singularFractionExactBoundary] using hbound

name: forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedMean_sub_observation
statement:
theorem forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedMean_sub_observation
    (posterior : ι → ℝ) (X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedMean
        posterior mean lambda n ω -
      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedObservation
        posterior X lambda n ω =
      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorMeanGap
        posterior X mean lambda n ω /
          forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight posterior lambda n ω
proof:
:= by
  unfold forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedMean
    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedObservation
    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorMeanGap
  rw [← sub_div]
  unfold posteriorAverage
  simp_rw [mul_sub]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  simp_rw [mul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: posteriorAverage_forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesScore
statement:
theorem posteriorAverage_forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesScore
    (posterior : ι → ℝ) (X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    posteriorAverage posterior
        (fun i ↦ forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesScore X mean lambda i n ω) =
      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorMeanGap
          posterior X mean lambda n ω -
        forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
          posterior X lambda n ω
proof:
:= by
  unfold forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesScore
    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorMeanGap
    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
  unfold posteriorAverage
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure_mass_le_delta
statement:
theorem forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure_mass_le_delta
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {prior : ι → ℝ} (hprior : IsFullSupportPMF prior)
    {X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {L delta : ℝ}
    (hL1 : L < 1) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hX_adapted : ∀ i, IncrementAdapted ℱ (X i))
    (hmean_adapted : ∀ i, StronglyAdapted ℱ (mean i))
    (hlambda_adapted : ∀ i, StronglyAdapted ℱ (lambda i))
    (hX_unit : ∀ i k ω, 0 ≤ X i k ω ∧ X i k ω ≤ 1)
    (hlambda_range : ∀ i k ω,
      0 ≤ lambda i k ω ∧ lambda i k ω ≤ L)
    (hmean : ∀ i k, μ[X i k | ℱ k] =ᵐ[μ] mean i k) :
    μ.real
        (forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure
          prior X mean lambda delta) ≤
      delta
proof:
:= by
  unfold forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure
  apply timeUniformScorePACBayes_allPosteriors_bound
    (μ := μ) (ℱ := ℱ) hprior ?_ hdelta
  intro i
  have hE :=
    forwardPredictableTiltMeanEmpiricalBernsteinLowerProcess_eProcess_of_bounded
      (F := ℱ) (X := X i) (mean := mean i) (lambda := lambda i)
      hL1 (hX_adapted i) (hmean_adapted i) (hlambda_adapted i)
      (hX_unit i) (hlambda_range i) (hmean i)
  have hprocess :
      (fun n ω ↦ Real.exp
        (forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesScore X mean lambda i n ω)) =
        forwardPredictableTiltMeanEmpiricalBernsteinLowerProcess
          (X i) (mean i) (lambda i) := by
    funext n ω
    symm
    simpa [forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesScore] using
      (forwardPredictableTiltMeanEmpiricalBernsteinLowerProcess_eq
        (X i) (mean i) (lambda i) n ω)
  rw [hprocess]
  exact hE

name: forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_allPosteriors_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_allPosteriors_of_not_mem
    {prior : ι → ℝ} {X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {delta : ℝ}
    {ω : Ω}
    (hω : ω ∉ forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure
      prior X mean lambda delta) :
    ∀ posterior : ι → ℝ, IsPMF posterior → ∀ n : ℕ,
      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorMeanGap
          posterior X mean lambda n ω <
        klDiv posterior prior + Real.log (1 / delta) +
          forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
            posterior X lambda n ω
proof:
:= by
  intro posterior hposterior n
  have hscore :
      posteriorAverage posterior
          (fun i ↦ forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesScore X mean lambda i n ω) <
        klDiv posterior prior + Real.log (1 / delta) := by
    apply lt_of_not_ge
    intro hfail
    apply hω
    exact ⟨n, posterior, hposterior, hfail⟩
  rw [posteriorAverage_forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesScore] at hscore
  linarith

name: forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_normalized_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_normalized_of_not_mem
    {prior : ι → ℝ} {X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {delta : ℝ}
    {ω : Ω}
    (hω : ω ∉ forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure
      prior X mean lambda delta)
    {posterior : ι → ℝ} (hposterior : IsPMF posterior) (n : ℕ)
    (hweight : 0 <
      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight posterior lambda n ω) :
    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedMean
        posterior mean lambda n ω <
      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedObservation
          posterior X lambda n ω +
        (klDiv posterior prior + Real.log (1 / delta) +
            forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
              posterior X lambda n ω) /
          forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight posterior lambda n ω
proof:
:= by
  have hgap := forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_allPosteriors_of_not_mem
    hω posterior hposterior n
  have hdiv :
      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorMeanGap posterior X mean lambda n ω /
          forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight posterior lambda n ω <
        (klDiv posterior prior + Real.log (1 / delta) +
            forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
              posterior X lambda n ω) /
          forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight posterior lambda n ω :=
    (div_lt_div_iff_of_pos_right hweight).2 hgap
  rw [← forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedMean_sub_observation
    posterior X mean lambda n ω] at hdiv
  linarith

name: forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_selected_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_selected_of_not_mem
    {prior : ι → ℝ} {X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {delta : ℝ}
    {ω : Ω}
    (hω : ω ∉ forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure
      prior X mean lambda delta)
    (posterior : Ω → ℕ → ι → ℝ)
    (hposterior : ∀ ω n, IsPMF (posterior ω n))
    (n : ℕ) :
    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorMeanGap
        (posterior ω n) X mean lambda n ω <
      klDiv (posterior ω n) prior + Real.log (1 / delta) +
        forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
          (posterior ω n) X lambda n ω
proof:
:=
  forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_allPosteriors_of_not_mem
    hω (posterior ω n) (hposterior ω n) n

name: forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_normalized_selected_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_normalized_selected_of_not_mem
    {prior : ι → ℝ} {X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {delta : ℝ}
    {ω : Ω}
    (hω : ω ∉ forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure
      prior X mean lambda delta)
    (posterior : Ω → ℕ → ι → ℝ)
    (hposterior : ∀ ω n, IsPMF (posterior ω n))
    (n : ℕ)
    (hweight : 0 < forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight
      (posterior ω n) lambda n ω) :
    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedMean
        (posterior ω n) mean lambda n ω <
      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedObservation
          (posterior ω n) X lambda n ω +
        (klDiv (posterior ω n) prior + Real.log (1 / delta) +
            forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
              (posterior ω n) X lambda n ω) /
          forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight
            (posterior ω n) lambda n ω
proof:
:=
  forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_normalized_of_not_mem
    hω (hposterior ω n) n hweight

name: exists_forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_event
statement:
theorem exists_forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_event
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {prior : ι → ℝ} (hprior : IsFullSupportPMF prior)
    {X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {L delta : ℝ}
    (hL1 : L < 1) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hX_adapted : ∀ i, IncrementAdapted ℱ (X i))
    (hmean_adapted : ∀ i, StronglyAdapted ℱ (mean i))
    (hlambda_adapted : ∀ i, StronglyAdapted ℱ (lambda i))
    (hX_unit : ∀ i k ω, 0 ≤ X i k ω ∧ X i k ω ≤ 1)
    (hlambda_range : ∀ i k ω,
      0 ≤ lambda i k ω ∧ lambda i k ω ≤ L)
    (hmean : ∀ i k, μ[X i k | ℱ k] =ᵐ[μ] mean i k) :
    ∃ goodEvent : Set Ω,
      μ.real goodEventᶜ ≤ delta ∧
        ∀ ω ∈ goodEvent, ∀ posterior : ι → ℝ, IsPMF posterior →
          ∀ n : ℕ,
            forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorMeanGap
                posterior X mean lambda n ω <
              klDiv posterior prior + Real.log (1 / delta) +
                forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
                  posterior X lambda n ω
proof:
:= by
  let badEvent := forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure
    prior X mean lambda delta
  refine ⟨badEventᶜ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [badEvent] using
      (forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure_mass_le_delta
        hprior hL1 hdelta hX_adapted hmean_adapted hlambda_adapted
          hX_unit hlambda_range hmean)
  · intro ω hω
    apply forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_allPosteriors_of_not_mem
    simpa [badEvent] using hω

name: exists_forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_normalized_event
statement:
theorem exists_forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_normalized_event
    [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {prior : ι → ℝ} (hprior : IsFullSupportPMF prior)
    {X mean lambda : ι → ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {L delta : ℝ}
    (hL1 : L < 1) (hdelta : 0 < delta)
    (hX_adapted : ∀ i, IncrementAdapted ℱ (X i))
    (hmean_adapted : ∀ i, StronglyAdapted ℱ (mean i))
    (hlambda_adapted : ∀ i, StronglyAdapted ℱ (lambda i))
    (hX_unit : ∀ i k ω, 0 ≤ X i k ω ∧ X i k ω ≤ 1)
    (hlambda_range : ∀ i k ω,
      0 ≤ lambda i k ω ∧ lambda i k ω ≤ L)
    (hmean : ∀ i k, μ[X i k | ℱ k] =ᵐ[μ] mean i k) :
    ∃ goodEvent : Set Ω,
      μ.real goodEventᶜ ≤ delta ∧
        ∀ ω ∈ goodEvent, ∀ posterior : ι → ℝ, IsPMF posterior →
          ∀ n : ℕ,
            0 < forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight
                posterior lambda n ω →
              forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedMean
                  posterior mean lambda n ω <
                forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorNormalizedObservation
                    posterior X lambda n ω +
                  (klDiv posterior prior + Real.log (1 / delta) +
                      forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorQuadraticPenalty
                        posterior X lambda n ω) /
                    forwardPredictableTiltPosteriorTotalWeight
                      posterior lambda n ω
proof:
:= by
  let badEvent := forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure
    prior X mean lambda delta
  refine ⟨badEventᶜ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [badEvent] using
      (forwardPredictableTiltPACBayesAnyPosteriorFailure_mass_le_delta
        hprior hL1 hdelta hX_adapted hmean_adapted hlambda_adapted
          hX_unit hlambda_range hmean)
  · intro ω hω posterior hposterior n hweight
    apply forwardPredictableTiltPACBayes_normalized_of_not_mem
      (posterior := posterior)
    · simpa [badEvent] using hω
    · exact hposterior
    · exact hweight

name: exp_iidContinuousScore_eq
statement:
theorem exp_iidContinuousScore_eq {d : ℕ} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    (dataLaw : Measure Z) (loss : GaussianParameterSpace d → Z → ℝ)
    (sample : ℕ → Ω → Z) (lam : ℝ) (θ : GaussianParameterSpace d)
    (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω) :
    Real.exp (iidContinuousScore dataLaw loss sample lam θ n ω) =
      subGammaExponentialProcess
        (iidLossGap dataLaw loss sample θ) 1 1 lam n ω
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayesUpperFailure_subset_processFailure
statement:
theorem timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayesUpperFailure_subset_processFailure
    {d : ℕ} [MeasurableSpace Z]
    {dataLaw : Measure Z} {prior posterior : SphericalGaussianParams d}
    {loss : GaussianParameterSpace d → Z → ℝ} {sample : ℕ → Ω → Z}
    {lam delta : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam)
    (hpop_int : Integrable (iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss)
      (sphericalGaussianMeasure posterior))
    (hemp_int : ∀ n ω, Integrable
      (fun θ => iidLossEmpiricalRisk loss sample θ n ω)
      (sphericalGaussianMeasure posterior)) :
    timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayesUpperFailure
        dataLaw prior posterior loss sample lam delta
      ⊆
    timeUniformSphericalGaussianPACBayesUpperFailure prior posterior
      (iidContinuousScore dataLaw loss sample lam) delta
proof:
:= by
  intro ω hω
  rcases hω with ⟨n, hn, hfail⟩
  refine ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
  have hnR : 0 < (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn
  have hden : 0 < (n : ℝ) * lam := mul_pos hnR hlam
  have hgap_int : Integrable
      (fun θ => iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss θ -
        iidLossEmpiricalRisk loss sample θ n ω)
      (sphericalGaussianMeasure posterior) :=
    hpop_int.sub (hemp_int n ω)
  have hscore_eq :
      (∫ θ, iidContinuousScore dataLaw loss sample lam θ n ω
          ∂sphericalGaussianMeasure posterior) =
        (n : ℝ) * lam *
            (gaussianPosteriorPopulationRisk dataLaw loss posterior -
              gaussianPosteriorEmpiricalRisk loss sample posterior n ω) -
          (n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam := by
    have hpoint : ∀ θ,
        iidContinuousScore dataLaw loss sample lam θ n ω =
          (n : ℝ) * lam *
              (iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss θ -
                iidLossEmpiricalRisk loss sample θ n ω) -
            (n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam := by
      intro θ
      have hmean := iidLossGap_runningMean dataLaw loss sample θ hn ω
      simp only [runningMean] at hmean
      unfold iidContinuousScore
      rw [show runningSum (iidLossGap dataLaw loss sample θ) n ω =
          (n : ℝ) *
            (iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss θ -
              iidLossEmpiricalRisk loss sample θ n ω) by
        calc
          runningSum (iidLossGap dataLaw loss sample θ) n ω =
              (runningSum (iidLossGap dataLaw loss sample θ) n ω / (n : ℝ)) *
                (n : ℝ) := by field_simp
          _ = (iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss θ -
                iidLossEmpiricalRisk loss sample θ n ω) * (n : ℝ) := by
              rw [hmean]
          _ = (n : ℝ) * (iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss θ -
                iidLossEmpiricalRisk loss sample θ n ω) := by ring]
      ring
    simp_rw [hpoint]
    rw [integral_sub]
    · rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub hpop_int (hemp_int n ω)]
      simp [gaussianPosteriorPopulationRisk,
        gaussianPosteriorEmpiricalRisk]
    · exact hgap_int.const_mul ((n : ℝ) * lam)
    · exact integrable_const _
  rw [hscore_eq]
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfail hden.le
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hnR, ne_of_gt hlam] at hmul
  nlinarith

name: timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayes_bound
statement:
theorem timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayes_bound
    {d : ℕ}
    [mZ : MeasurableSpace Z] [TopologicalSpace Z] [BorelSpace Z]
    [TopologicalSpace.MetrizableSpace Z]
    [mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    {dataLaw : Measure Z} [IsProbabilityMeasure dataLaw]
    (prior posterior : SphericalGaussianParams d)
    {loss : GaussianParameterSpace d → Z → ℝ}
    {sample : ℕ → Ω → Z} {lam delta : ℝ}
    (hδ : 0 < delta) (hlam : 0 < lam) (hlam_three : lam < 3)
    (hloss_joint : StronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Z => loss p.1 p.2))
    (hloss_range : ∀ θ z, 0 ≤ loss θ z ∧ loss θ z ≤ 1)
    (hsample : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable (sample k))
    (hsample_indep : iIndepFun sample μ)
    (hsample_law : ∀ k, HasLaw (sample k) dataLaw μ) :
    μ.real (timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayesUpperFailure
      dataLaw prior posterior loss sample lam delta) ≤ delta
proof:
:= by
  let ℱ : Filtration ℕ mΩ := Filtration.natural sample hsample
  let X : GaussianParameterSpace d → ℕ → Ω → ℝ :=
    iidLossGap dataLaw loss sample
  let score : GaussianParameterSpace d → ℕ → Ω → ℝ :=
    iidContinuousScore dataLaw loss sample lam
  have hloss : ∀ θ, StronglyMeasurable (loss θ) := by
    intro θ
    exact hloss_joint.comp_measurable (measurable_const.prodMk measurable_id)
  have hrisk_range : ∀ θ,
      iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss θ ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro θ
    exact iidLossPopulationRisk_mem_Icc
      (dataLaw := dataLaw) θ (hloss θ) (hloss_range θ)
  have hrisk_meas : StronglyMeasurable
      (iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss) := by
    change StronglyMeasurable (fun θ => ∫ z, loss θ z ∂dataLaw)
    exact hloss_joint.integral_prod_right (ν := dataLaw)
  have hX_joint : ∀ k, StronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω => X p.1 k p.2) := by
    intro k
    have hobs : StronglyMeasurable
        (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
          loss p.1 (sample (k + 1) p.2)) :=
      hloss_joint.comp_measurable
        (measurable_fst.prodMk ((hsample (k + 1)).measurable.comp measurable_snd))
    change StronglyMeasurable
      ((fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
          iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss p.1) -
        fun p => loss p.1 (sample (k + 1) p.2))
    exact (hrisk_meas.comp_measurable measurable_fst).sub hobs
  have hX_meas : ∀ θ k, Measurable (X θ k) := by
    intro θ k
    exact iidLossGap_measurable θ k (hloss θ) hsample
  have hX_bound : ∀ θ k ω, |X θ k ω| ≤ (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro θ k ω
    exact abs_iidLossGap_le_one θ k ω (hloss θ) (hloss_range θ)
  have hX_int : ∀ θ k, Integrable (X θ k) μ := by
    intro θ k
    exact iidLossGap_integrable θ k (hloss θ) (hloss_range θ) hsample
  have hsample_adapted := Filtration.stronglyAdapted_natural hsample
  have hX_adapted : ∀ θ, IncrementAdapted ℱ (X θ) := by
    intro θ
    exact iidLossGap_incrementAdapted θ (hloss θ) hsample
  have hcenter : ∀ θ k, μ[X θ k | ℱ k] =ᵐ[μ] 0 := by
    intro θ k
    exact iidLossGap_condExp_eq_zero θ k (hloss θ) (hloss_range θ)
      hsample hsample_indep hsample_law
  have hvar : ∀ θ k,
      μ[fun ω => (X θ k ω) ^ 2 | ℱ k] ≤ᵐ[μ] fun _ => (1 : ℝ) := by
    intro θ k
    exact iidLossGap_condExp_sq_le_one θ k (hloss θ) (hloss_range θ) hsample
  have hM_int : ∀ θ n,
      Integrable (subGammaExponentialProcess (X θ) 1 1 lam n) μ := by
    intro θ n
    exact integrable_subGammaExponentialProcess_of_bounded n
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hlam.le (by simpa using hlam_three)
      (hX_meas θ) (fun k => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => hX_bound θ k ω)
  have hfixed : ∀ θ,
      Supermartingale (fun n ω => Real.exp (score θ n ω)) ℱ μ := by
    intro θ
    have hadapted :=
      stronglyAdapted_subGammaExponentialProcess_of_adapted 1 1 lam
        (hX_adapted θ)
    have hsup : Supermartingale
        (subGammaExponentialProcess (X θ) 1 1 lam) ℱ μ :=
      (nonneg_supermartingale_of_condSubGamma hadapted (hM_int θ)
        (condSubGamma_supermartingale_step
          (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hlam.le (by simpa using hlam_three)
          (hX_meas θ) (hX_int θ) hadapted
          (fun k => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => hX_bound θ k ω)
          (hcenter θ) (hvar θ))).1
    change Supermartingale
      (subGammaExponentialProcess
        (iidLossGap dataLaw loss sample θ) 1 1 lam) ℱ μ
    exact hsup
  have hscore_joint : ∀ n, StronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω => score p.1 n p.2) := by
    intro n
    have hsum : StronglyMeasurable
        (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
          runningSum (X p.1) n p.2) := by
      have heq : (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
          runningSum (X p.1) n p.2) =
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, fun p => X p.1 k p.2 := by
        funext p
        simp [runningSum, Finset.sum_apply]
      rw [heq]
      exact Finset.stronglyMeasurable_sum _ fun k _ => hX_joint k
    change StronglyMeasurable
      (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
        lam * runningSum (X p.1) n p.2 -
          (n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam)
    exact (hsum.const_mul lam).sub stronglyMeasurable_const
  have hscore_bound : ∀ θ n ω,
      |score θ n ω| ≤
        lam * (n : ℝ) + |(n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam| := by
    intro θ n ω
    have hsum_abs : |runningSum (X θ) n ω| ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
      calc
        |runningSum (X θ) n ω| ≤
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, |X θ k ω| := by
              simpa [runningSum] using
                (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs (s := Finset.range n)
                  (f := fun k => X θ k ω))
        _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 : ℝ) := by
              exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => hX_bound θ k ω
        _ = (n : ℝ) := by simp
    change |lam * runningSum (X θ) n ω -
      (n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam| ≤ _
    calc
      |lam * runningSum (X θ) n ω - (n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam| ≤
          |lam * runningSum (X θ) n ω| +
            |(n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam| := abs_sub _ _
      _ ≤ lam * (n : ℝ) + |(n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam| := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos hlam]
          simpa [add_comm] using
            (add_le_add_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum_abs hlam.le)
              |(n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam|)
  have hexp_joint_int_prior : ∀ n,
      Integrable (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
        Real.exp (score p.1 n p.2))
        ((sphericalGaussianMeasure prior).prod μ) := by
    intro n
    refine Integrable.of_bound (Real.continuous_exp.comp_stronglyMeasurable
      (hscore_joint n)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Real.exp (lam * (n : ℝ) + |(n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam|)) ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_abs_self _).trans (hscore_bound p.1 n p.2))
  have hscore_section_int : ∀ n ω,
      Integrable (fun θ => score θ n ω)
        (sphericalGaussianMeasure posterior) := by
    intro n ω
    refine Integrable.of_bound
      ((hscore_joint n).comp_measurable
        (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const)).aestronglyMeasurable
      (lam * (n : ℝ) + |(n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam|) ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => hscore_bound θ n ω
  have hexp_section_int : ∀ n ω,
      Integrable (fun θ => Real.exp (score θ n ω))
        (sphericalGaussianMeasure prior) := by
    intro n ω
    refine Integrable.of_bound
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp_stronglyMeasurable
        ((hscore_joint n).comp_measurable
          (measurable_id.prodMk measurable_const))).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Real.exp (lam * (n : ℝ) + |(n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam|)) ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_abs_self _).trans (hscore_bound θ n ω))
  have hpop_int : Integrable (iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss)
      (sphericalGaussianMeasure posterior) :=
    Integrable.of_bound hrisk_meas.aestronglyMeasurable 1
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hrisk_range θ).1]
        exact (hrisk_range θ).2)
  have hemp_int : ∀ n ω, Integrable
      (fun θ => iidLossEmpiricalRisk loss sample θ n ω)
      (sphericalGaussianMeasure posterior) := by
    intro n ω
    by_cases hn : n = 0
    · subst n
      simp [iidLossEmpiricalRisk]
    · have hemp_meas : StronglyMeasurable
          (fun θ => iidLossEmpiricalRisk loss sample θ n ω) := by
        unfold iidLossEmpiricalRisk
        change StronglyMeasurable
          (fun θ => (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, loss θ (sample (k + 1) ω)) *
            (n : ℝ)⁻¹)
        apply StronglyMeasurable.mul_const
        have heq : (fun θ : GaussianParameterSpace d =>
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, loss θ (sample (k + 1) ω)) =
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n,
              (fun θ : GaussianParameterSpace d => loss θ (sample (k + 1) ω)) := by
          funext θ
          simp [Finset.sum_apply]
        rw [heq]
        apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_sum
        intro k _hk
        simpa [Function.comp_def] using
          hloss_joint.comp_measurable
            (measurable_id.prodMk (measurable_const :
              Measurable (fun _ : GaussianParameterSpace d => sample (k + 1) ω)))
      refine Integrable.of_bound hemp_meas.aestronglyMeasurable 1 ?_
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun θ => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
        · have hsum_le :
              (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, loss θ (sample (k + 1) ω)) ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
            calc
              _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range n, (1 : ℝ) :=
                Finset.sum_le_sum fun k _ => (hloss_range θ _).2
              _ = (n : ℝ) := by simp
          exact (div_le_one (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn))).mpr hsum_le
        · exact div_nonneg
            (Finset.sum_nonneg fun k _ => (hloss_range θ _).1) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  have h_adapted_mix : StronglyAdapted ℱ
      (continuousExponentialMixtureProcess
        (sphericalGaussianMeasure prior) score) := by
    intro n
    have hjoint : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance :
        MeasurableSpace (GaussianParameterSpace d)).prod (ℱ n)]
        (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
          Real.exp (score p.1 n p.2)) := by
      have hsum : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance :
          MeasurableSpace (GaussianParameterSpace d)).prod (ℱ n)]
          (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
            runningSum (X p.1) n p.2) := by
        have heq : (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
            runningSum (X p.1) n p.2) =
            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, fun p => X p.1 k p.2 := by
          funext p
          simp [runningSum, Finset.sum_apply]
        rw [heq]
        apply Finset.stronglyMeasurable_sum
        intro k hk
        have hklt : k < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hk
        have hobs : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance :
            MeasurableSpace (GaussianParameterSpace d)).prod (ℱ n)]
            (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
              loss p.1 (sample (k + 1) p.2)) := by
          exact hloss_joint.comp_measurable
            (measurable_fst.prodMk
              (((hsample_adapted (k + 1)).mono
                (ℱ.mono (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hklt))).measurable.comp measurable_snd))
        change StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance :
            MeasurableSpace (GaussianParameterSpace d)).prod (ℱ n)]
          ((fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
              iidLossPopulationRisk dataLaw loss p.1) -
            fun p => loss p.1 (sample (k + 1) p.2))
        exact (hrisk_meas.comp_measurable measurable_fst).sub hobs
      have hbody : StronglyMeasurable[(inferInstance :
          MeasurableSpace (GaussianParameterSpace d)).prod (ℱ n)]
          (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
            lam * runningSum (X p.1) n p.2 -
              (n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam) :=
        (hsum.const_mul lam).sub stronglyMeasurable_const
      exact Real.continuous_exp.comp_stronglyMeasurable hbody
    change StronglyMeasurable[ℱ n]
      (fun ω => ∫ θ, Real.exp (score θ n ω)
        ∂sphericalGaussianMeasure prior)
    letI : MeasurableSpace Ω := ℱ n
    exact (hjoint.comp_measurable measurable_swap).integral_prod_right'
  have h_integrable_mix : ∀ n, Integrable
      (continuousExponentialMixtureProcess
        (sphericalGaussianMeasure prior) score n) μ := by
    intro n
    exact (hexp_joint_int_prior n).integral_prod_right
  have hM_int_next : ∀ n, Integrable
      (fun p : GaussianParameterSpace d × Ω =>
        Real.exp (score p.1 (n + 1) p.2))
      ((sphericalGaussianMeasure prior).prod μ) :=
    fun n => hexp_joint_int_prior (n + 1)
  have hM_int_current : ∀ n, Integrable
      (fun p : Ω × GaussianParameterSpace d =>
        Real.exp (score p.2 n p.1))
      (μ.prod (sphericalGaussianMeasure prior)) := by
    intro n
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using (hexp_joint_int_prior n).swap
  have hM_int_restrict : ∀ n, ∀ {s : Set Ω}, MeasurableSet s → μ s < ⊤ →
      Integrable (fun p : Ω × GaussianParameterSpace d =>
        Real.exp (score p.2 n p.1))
      ((μ.restrict s).prod (sphericalGaussianMeasure prior)) := by
    intro n s hs hμs
    have hmeas : StronglyMeasurable
        (fun p : Ω × GaussianParameterSpace d =>
          Real.exp (score p.2 n p.1)) :=
      (Real.continuous_exp.comp_stronglyMeasurable
        ((hscore_joint n).comp_measurable measurable_swap))
    refine Integrable.of_bound hmeas.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Real.exp (lam * (n : ℝ) + |(n : ℝ) * subGammaCgf 1 1 lam|)) ?_
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ((le_abs_self _).trans (hscore_bound p.2 n p.1))
  have hprocess := timeUniformSphericalGaussianPACBayes_bound
    (μ := μ) (ℱ := ℱ) prior posterior score hδ h_adapted_mix
    h_integrable_mix hM_int_next
    (fun n s hs hμs => hM_int_restrict (n + 1) hs hμs)
    hM_int_current hM_int_restrict
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hfixed)
    (fun θ ω => by simp [score, iidContinuousScore, runningSum])
    hexp_section_int hscore_section_int
  exact (measureReal_mono
    (timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayesUpperFailure_subset_processFailure
      (dataLaw := dataLaw) (prior := prior) (posterior := posterior)
      (loss := loss) (sample := sample) (lam := lam) (delta := delta)
      hlam hpop_int hemp_int)).trans hprocess

name: unitSample_iIndep
statement:
theorem unitSample_iIndep :
    iIndepFun unitSample (Measure.dirac ())
proof:
:= by
  change iIndepFun (fun _ : ℕ => fun _ : Unit => ()) (Measure.dirac ())
  rw [iIndepFun_iff_measure_inter_preimage_eq_mul]
  intro S sets _hsets
  simp
  by_cases hall : ∀ i ∈ S, () ∈ sets i
  · have hmem : () ∈ ⋂ i ∈ S, sets i := by
      simp only [Set.mem_iInter]
      exact fun i => fun hi => hall i hi
    rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hmem]
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_one]
    · simp
    · intro i hi
      exact Set.indicator_of_mem (hall i hi) (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ENNReal))
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Classical.not_forall.mp hall
    obtain ⟨hiS, hnot⟩ := Classical.not_imp.mp hi
    have hnotmem : () ∉ ⋂ i ∈ S, sets i := by
      intro hmem
      exact hnot (Set.mem_iInter.mp (Set.mem_iInter.mp hmem i) hiS)
    rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hnotmem]
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero hiS]
    exact Set.indicator_of_notMem hnot (fun _ : Unit => (1 : ENNReal))

name: unitHalfLoss_endToEnd_certificate
statement:
theorem unitHalfLoss_endToEnd_certificate :
    (Measure.dirac ()).real
        (timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayesUpperFailure
          (Measure.dirac ()) standardGaussianPrior shiftedGaussianPosterior
          unitHalfLoss unitSample 1 (Real.exp (-1))) ≤
      Real.exp (-1)
proof:
:= by
  refine timeUniformIIDGaussianPACBayes_bound
    (μ := Measure.dirac ()) (dataLaw := Measure.dirac ())
    standardGaussianPrior shiftedGaussianPosterior
    (loss := unitHalfLoss) (sample := unitSample)
    (lam := 1) (delta := Real.exp (-1))
    (Real.exp_pos _)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) ?_ ?_ ?_ unitSample_iIndep ?_
  · exact stronglyMeasurable_const
  · intro θ z
    norm_num [unitHalfLoss]
  · intro k
    exact stronglyMeasurable_const
  · intro k
    exact hasLaw_dirac_of_ae_eq
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω => by simp [unitSample])

    (hw : ∀ c, 0 < w c) (hw_summable : Summable w)
    {delta : ℝ} (S : Fin n → Z)
    (hS : S ∉ countableJointMeanVarianceCatalogBadSamples
      n p prior ell t eta w delta)
    (c : ℕ) {rho : ι → ℝ} (hrho : IsPMF rho) :
    posteriorAverage rho
        (fun i => finiteJointMeanVarianceScore n p ell (t c) (eta c) i S) ≤
      klDiv rho prior + Real.log (1 / (delta * w c))
proof:
:= by
  have hsingleton := finiteSingleton_not_mem_of_countable_not_mem
    hn p hp hprior.toIsPMF ell hell ht heta hkappa hw hw_summable S hS c
  simpa using
    (finiteJointMeanVariance_posteriorScore_le_of_not_mem
      (κ := Unit) (t := fun _ : Unit => t c)
      (eta := fun _ : Unit => eta c) (w := fun _ : Unit => w c)
      n p hprior ell (fun _ => hw c) S hsingleton () hrho)

name: countableJointMeanVariance_posteriorGap_le_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem countableJointMeanVariance_posteriorGap_le_of_not_mem
    [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p : Z → ℝ) (hp : IsPMF p)
    {prior : ι → ℝ} (hprior : IsFullSupportPMF prior)
    (ell : ι → Z → ℝ)
    (hell : ∀ i z, ell i z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {t eta w : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ht : ∀ c, 0 ≤ t c) (heta : ∀ c, 0 ≤ eta c)
    (hkappa : ∀ c, 0 ≤ finiteJointMeanVarianceKappa n (eta c))
    (hw : ∀ c, 0 < w c) (hw_summable : Summable w)
    {delta : ℝ} (S : Fin n → Z)
    (hS : S ∉ countableJointMeanVarianceCatalogBadSamples
      n p prior ell t eta w delta)
    (c : ℕ) {rho : ι → ℝ} (hrho : IsPMF rho) :
    t c * (n : ℝ) *
        (posteriorAverage rho (finitePopulationRisk p ell) -
          posteriorAverage rho (fun i => finiteEmpiricalRisk ell i S)) ≤
      klDiv rho prior + Real.log (1 / (delta * w c)) +
        eta c * (n : ℝ) *
          posteriorAverage rho (fun i => finiteEmpiricalVariance ell i S) +
        (n : ℝ) *
          Real.log
            (1 + (Real.exp (t c) - 1 - t c) *
              posteriorAverage rho (finitePopulationVariance p ell)) -
        Real.exp (-t c) * finiteJointMeanVarianceKappa n (eta c) *
          posteriorAverage rho (finitePopulationVariance p ell)
proof:
:= by
  have hsingleton := finiteSingleton_not_mem_of_countable_not_mem
    hn p hp hprior.toIsPMF ell hell ht heta hkappa hw hw_summable S hS c
  simpa using
    (finiteJointMeanVariance_posteriorGap_le_of_not_mem
      (κ := Unit) (t := fun _ : Unit => t c)
      (eta := fun _ : Unit => eta c) (w := fun _ : Unit => w c)
      n p hp hprior ell (fun _ => hw c) S hsingleton () hrho)

name: countableJointMeanVariance_posteriorRisk_le_with_xi_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem countableJointMeanVariance_posteriorRisk_le_with_xi_of_not_mem
    [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p : Z → ℝ) (hp : IsPMF p)
    {prior : ι → ℝ} (hprior : IsFullSupportPMF prior)
    (ell : ι → Z → ℝ)
    (hell : ∀ i z, ell i z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {t eta w : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ht : ∀ c, 0 ≤ t c) (heta : ∀ c, 0 ≤ eta c)
    (hkappa : ∀ c, 0 ≤ finiteJointMeanVarianceKappa n (eta c))
    (hw : ∀ c, 0 < w c) (hw_summable : Summable w)
    {delta : ℝ} (S : Fin n → Z)
    (hS : S ∉ countableJointMeanVarianceCatalogBadSamples
      n p prior ell t eta w delta)
    (c : ℕ) (htc : 0 < t c)
    {rho : ι → ℝ} (hrho : IsPMF rho) :
    posteriorAverage rho (finitePopulationRisk p ell) ≤
      posteriorAverage rho (fun i => finiteEmpiricalRisk ell i S) +
        (klDiv rho prior + Real.log (1 / (delta * w c))) /
          (t c * (n : ℝ)) +
        (eta c / t c) *
          posteriorAverage rho (fun i => finiteEmpiricalVariance ell i S) +
        finiteJointMeanVarianceXi n (t c) (eta c) / t c
proof:
:= by
  have hsingleton := finiteSingleton_not_mem_of_countable_not_mem
    hn p hp hprior.toIsPMF ell hell ht heta hkappa hw hw_summable S hS c
  simpa using
    (finiteJointMeanVariance_posteriorRisk_le_with_xi_of_not_mem
      (κ := Unit) (t := fun _ : Unit => t c)
      (eta := fun _ : Unit => eta c) (w := fun _ : Unit => w c)
      hn p hp hprior ell hell (fun _ => hw c) S hsingleton () htc
        (hkappa c) hrho)

name: countableJointMeanVariance_posteriorRisk_le_with_xi_selected_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem countableJointMeanVariance_posteriorRisk_le_with_xi_selected_of_not_mem
    [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z] [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (p : Z → ℝ) (hp : IsPMF p)
    {prior : ι → ℝ} (hprior : IsFullSupportPMF prior)
    (ell : ι → Z → ℝ)
    (hell : ∀ i z, ell i z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    {t eta w : ℕ → ℝ}
    (ht_pos : ∀ c, 0 < t c) (heta : ∀ c, 0 ≤ eta c)
    (hkappa : ∀ c, 0 ≤ finiteJointMeanVarianceKappa n (eta c))
    (hw : ∀ c, 0 < w c) (hw_summable : Summable w)
    (select : (Fin n → Z) → (ι → ℝ) → ℕ)
    {delta : ℝ} (S : Fin n → Z)
    (hS : S ∉ countableJointMeanVarianceCatalogBadSamples
      n p prior ell t eta w delta)
    {rho : ι → ℝ} (hrho : IsPMF rho) :
    posteriorAverage rho (finitePopulationRisk p ell) ≤
      posteriorAverage rho (fun i => finiteEmpiricalRisk ell i S) +
        (klDiv rho prior +
            Real.log (1 / (delta * w (select S rho)))) /
          (t (select S rho) * (n : ℝ)) +
        (eta (select S rho) / t (select S rho)) *
          posteriorAverage rho (fun i => finiteEmpiricalVariance ell i S) +
        finiteJointMeanVarianceXi n

name: finitePopulationVariance_nonneg
statement:
theorem finitePopulationVariance_nonneg [Fintype Z]
    (p : Z → ℝ) (hp : IsPMF p) (ℓ : ι → Z → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    0 ≤ finitePopulationVariance p ℓ i
proof:
:= by
  unfold finitePopulationVariance
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg
    (fun z _ => mul_nonneg (hp.nonneg z) (sq_nonneg _))

name: finitePopulationVariance_eq_secondMoment_sub_riskSq
statement:
theorem finitePopulationVariance_eq_secondMoment_sub_riskSq [Fintype Z]
    (p : Z → ℝ) (hp : IsPMF p) (ℓ : ι → Z → ℝ) (i : ι) :
    finitePopulationVariance p ℓ i =
      (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat)) -
        (finitePopulationRisk p ℓ i) ^ (2 : Nat)
proof:
:= by
  let R := finitePopulationRisk p ℓ i
  have hR : (∑ z : Z, p z * ℓ i z) = R := by
    rfl
  have hconst : (∑ z : Z, p z * R ^ (2 : Nat)) = R ^ (2 : Nat) := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hp.sum_one, one_mul]
  have hlinear :
      (∑ z : Z, p z * (2 * ℓ i z * R)) = 2 * R * R := by
    calc
      (∑ z : Z, p z * (2 * ℓ i z * R)) =
          2 * R * ∑ z : Z, p z * ℓ i z := by
            rw [Finset.mul_sum]
            refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
            ring
      _ = 2 * R * R := by rw [hR]
  unfold finitePopulationVariance
  change
    (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z - R) ^ (2 : Nat)) =
      (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat)) - R ^ (2 : Nat)
  calc
    (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z - R) ^ (2 : Nat)) =
        ∑ z : Z,
          (p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat) -
            p z * (2 * ℓ i z * R) + p z * R ^ (2 : Nat)) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun z _ => ?_)
          ring
    _ = (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat)) -
          (∑ z : Z, p z * (2 * ℓ i z * R)) +
          (∑ z : Z, p z * R ^ (2 : Nat)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat)) - 2 * R * R + R ^ (2 : Nat) := by
          rw [hlinear, hconst]
    _ = (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat)) - R ^ (2 : Nat) := by
          ring

name: finitePopulationRisk_mem_Icc_of_bounded
statement:
theorem finitePopulationRisk_mem_Icc_of_bounded [Fintype Z]
    (p : Z → ℝ) (hp : IsPMF p) (ℓ : ι → Z → ℝ) (i : ι)
    (hℓ : ∀ z : Z, ℓ i z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    finitePopulationRisk p ℓ i ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · unfold finitePopulationRisk
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg
      (fun z _ => mul_nonneg (hp.nonneg z) (hℓ z).1)
  · unfold finitePopulationRisk
    calc
      (∑ z : Z, p z * ℓ i z) ≤ ∑ z : Z, p z * 1 := by
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum
          (fun z _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hℓ z).2 (hp.nonneg z))
      _ = 1 := by simp [hp.sum_one]

name: finitePopulationVariance_le_quarter
statement:
theorem finitePopulationVariance_le_quarter [Fintype Z]
    (p : Z → ℝ) (hp : IsPMF p) (ℓ : ι → Z → ℝ) (i : ι)
    (hℓ : ∀ z : Z, ℓ i z ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    finitePopulationVariance p ℓ i ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4
proof:
:= by
  let R := finitePopulationRisk p ℓ i
  have hR := finitePopulationRisk_mem_Icc_of_bounded p hp ℓ i hℓ
  have hsecond :
      (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat)) ≤ R := by
    change (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat)) ≤
      ∑ z : Z, p z * ℓ i z
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun z _ => by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (hp.nonneg z)
      nlinarith [(mul_nonneg (hℓ z).1 (sub_nonneg.mpr (hℓ z).2))])
  rw [finitePopulationVariance_eq_secondMoment_sub_riskSq p hp ℓ i]
  calc
    (∑ z : Z, p z * (ℓ i z) ^ (2 : Nat)) - R ^ (2 : Nat)
        ≤ R - R ^ (2 : Nat) := sub_le_sub_right hsecond _
    _ ≤ (1 : ℝ) / 4 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (R - (1 : ℝ) / 2)]

proof:
